findings.observed: The injected-event control adds its synthetic row with UNION ALL after `FROM events WHERE seq > $1`, so the row never passes through the seq baseline filter. The control proves the organization/actor/subject predicate detects a suite event. It does not prove the baseline window admits post-baseline events: if eventBaselineSeq were ever captured too late (or compared wrongly), the real no-event check would become vacuous while the control still passed.

regression_proof.description: Moving the baseline capture after fixture creation, or setting it to MAX(seq)+1000, makes the injected control fail.
